summary: Executed exactly one canonical PPA install configuration transaction (scripts/hpac_protected_presentation_admin.py install) against the existing, previously-verified generation-1 protected root, after two non-blocking environmental obstacles were hit, root-caused without a blind retry, and cleared: (1) a first attempt failed closed with acl_inspection_unavailable because the operator's interactive-shell PATH has uid-501(configured-agent)-writable directories preceding /usr/bin and /bin -- the ACL-tool-trust guard working as designed, confirmed by reproducing the same resolver call read-only with the real vs. a sanitized PATH; (2) a second attempt with a sanitized PATH failed with ModuleNotFoundError because that PATH resolved python3 to Apple's system interpreter, which lacks the repo's editable-install sys.path entry -- confirmed read-only by running the same script unprivileged and observing import success. The third attempt (sanitized PATH for the internal ls/getfacl trust check, combined with an explicit full path to the Homebrew interpreter for module resolution) succeeded: install ok, installation_id hppi-648bee5e950b4f5e971a6c65c8cc53cf, generation 1, descriptor_digest c4e9a04d8d4af865372d78db280b8a2ba40f7ad29414b365acf87b775b13fc6e. Post-registration read-back (independently re-derived, not merely trusted from the CLI's own exit code) confirmed: write set confined to exactly the three authorized files under presentation-mechanisms/v2/pcae-protected-local-presentation/ (descriptor.json, installations/1/installation.json, current-generation.json); installation_digest and anchor_digest both independently recompute via the repository's own canonical_digest self-excluding-field algorithm; descriptor_digest agrees across all three records and installation_digest agrees between installation.json and current-generation.json (currentness binding correct); the installed helper, re-hashed after registration, is unchanged and still byte-identical to the pinned generation-1 immutable source (933c664...9ea6182); the protected root and its full ancestor chain, re-stat'd directly, remain root-owned (uid=0, modes 0700/0755) with the configured agent (uid 501) having zero write access anywhere in the chain; the PAWA anchor (generation 1, installation_id hpawi-bfc91d..., agent-exclusion ACTIVE) is unchanged from the predecessor phase. One additional exception was hit during ad hoc post-registration read-back (ProtectedPresentationIntegrityError via an unbound HPACStoreAuthority.production()) and was fully root-caused to the diagnostic script's own API misuse (falls back to the live process identity -- root under sudo -- when no PAWA writer factory has bound the configured-agent identity, and root trivially owns the root it provisioned); the raw stat-based readback independently confirms no real topology defect. No src/pcae, scripts/, pyproject.toml, or docs/contracts change was made or is proposed. A bounded, targeted regression band (RHAMP/PPA/Gate5/hpac_verifier suites) ran 468 passed, 5 failed, all five confirmed pre-existing and unattributable to this phase (git diff since phase entry against src/pcae, scripts, and pyproject.toml is empty). N-16-5 remains NOT CLOSED (registration is not deployment-state IV, and is not the final human/YubiKey certification). N-16-6/N-16-7 untouched.
